jobs.description:
Do you possess an IRATA Level 3 certificate, are you technically skilled, and do you enjoy working at heights? Do you enjoy leading and supervising operational teams, with a keen eye for safety and quality, and do you also like to roll up your sleeves? Furthermore, do you have an affinity for technical work and various industries, and are you up for working on the most challenging projects in hard-to-reach locations, such as at height and in confined spaces? Then this position as Rope Access Technician/Supervisor at Sky-Access B.V. is exactly what you are looking for! Company is based in Roosendaal.

Who are we looking for?
We are looking for someone:

• With a valid IRATA level 3 certificate (hard demand)
• Who enjoys being physically active in their work
• Who has an affinity for working safely, the various industries, and technology
• With a flexible and positive work attitude, a team player
• Who has technical insight and enjoys working with their hands
• With a technical background
• With the necessary capabilities and ambition to take responsibility for rope safety on the projects
• Who takes initiative, both solicited and unsolicited, and provides advice on IRATA-related knowledge, skills, and methodologies
• Who is willing to work occasionally at irregular times (weekends/nights)
• With a good command of English
• Who holds a B driving license
• With VCA-VOL certification (or willing to obtain it)

________________________________________

What do we offer you?
• Contract duration: Intention is a permanent contract. First year a fixed term contract of 12 months (will be changed into a permanent contract if skills, performance and work attitude are meeting company demands)
Trial period: 1 month
Salary range (gross/month): €3.500 – €4.000 in accordance with the Collective Labour Agreement for the Small Metal Industry
Housing: Employer offers suitable housing for the first period (to help the foreign colleque) – for this a contribution of the costs are for the account of employee (cost indication: between € 500 and € 600)
• A varied and challenging job within an enthusiastic and close-knit team
• Ample opportunities for personal development (IRATA upgrades, courses, advancement to project manager, IRATA part-time roles)
• Working on unique and technically challenging projects, both nationally and internationally
• Support and guidance in your career and certification processes
• A no-nonsense company culture with a focus on safety and quality

SSAB Services, Hardox Wearparts is a rapidly growing business unit with ambitious targets. As Business & Technical Development Manager for Hardox Wearparts you will be an integral part of building and implementing a new business model. 

You will participate in the development and conceptualization of the new business model, including the future product and service mix as well as the go-to market setup. Placement is optional.

Responsibilities include

•Business concept: Conceptualization and structuring of existing knowledge in order to define the  service offer

•Product and service portfolio evaluation and definition

•Development of trainings and manuals

•Piloting the new concept, preparing for future concept sales

•Mapping end user needs to ensure concept success

You will report to the Head of Hardox Wearparts Concept Management.

Your qualifications
To be successful in this role you need to have a master degree in engineering or equivalent. 

We believe that you have at least 5 years experience of working with wear products and/or maintenance in the one of the aggregates industries. You have strong social skills and experience from successfully driving and implementing development. 

You have a curious mind and strong analytical skills paired with good technical understanding of wear in practice (maintenance and wear products). As a lot of the future development will have a strong connection to digital tools and systems development, you need an overall understanding of the possibilities that exist within digital development. 

You are fluent in English and thrive in an international environment where global contacts are part of the every day work. Speaking Dutch is a plus as the position wil be based in the Netherlands.

As a person you are positive and interested in new ideas - and in making them happen. 

We offer
You will be part of, and have the possibility to grow within, an international and dynamic organization that is developing rapidly. Hardox Wearparts has ambitious growth targets and as a vital member of the development team, you will contribute to our future success. 

Application
Send your application no later than 20th of March 2019

For more information, please contact
Nancy Matos, Manager Hardox Wearparts Concept, phone +46 155 255 422

We are looking for packing employees who are available to work in a three-shift system (food industry) in Dendermonde?

If you're interested, read the job description and apply!

You will be working in the packing department of a company that specializes in packaging frozen products. This role involves working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 10°C).

Your main tasks include:

• Checking product quality

• Packing various products (such as fish, snacks, vegetables, etc.) into boxes or bags

• Applying labels

• Stacking boxes on pallets

• Other related tasks

jobs.occupation: Commercial Coordinator for the Beer Sector
jobs.description:
The Commercial Coordinator role within the FMCG industry focuses on supporting sales, logistics, customer service operations in the beer sector. This position requires organisational skills to manage customer interactions and ensure smooth process optimizations.

Client Details

Our client is a main beer actor in the Belgian industry.

They have a history of knowledge and expertise and are located in Flemish Brabant.

Description

As a Commercial Coordinator your responsibilities are very varied but with as a main goal to optimize all commercial, logistics and sales support processes in the company.

 

Concretely you will:

 

• You work closely with Sales Support, Customer Service, Finance, Marketing, and Supply Chain to ensure efficient commercial operations
• You support and optimize all ongoing commercial processes and give insights on how to make the collaboration between sales, sales support and logistics more efficient
• You analyze commercial figures, market tendencies, promotions to increase commercial insights
• You analyze demand planning processes, market tendencies in the sector to make sure the forecasts are more accurate
• You support sales, sales support, customer service and logistics teams in using the CRM tool well
• You guarantee a flawless and efficient OTC process
 

 

The Commercial Coordinator should have:

• Fluent Dutch, French and English
• Analytical insights
• Able to understand different businesses and how an entire Order To Cash process works
• Good communication and influencing skills

About K-Boringen:With its trenchless installation of pipelines and tunnels, K-Boringen has built a groundbreaking international reputation. Equipped with an extensive fleet of machinery and supported by more than 55 expert employees, K-Boringen guarantees an extremely smooth and flexible service, even in the most challenging work situations. To ensure continued growth, we are currently looking for new colleagues.Being naturally multilingual and equipped with an impressive machine park, the people at K-Boringen ensure an exceptionally smooth and flexible collaboration, even in the most demanding work conditions.Using tunnel boring machines, our professionals drill (micro)tunnels with diameters of up to 4 meters over lengths of, for example, 1 km. More information can be found at https://www.k-boringen.com/.To carry out our drilling projects across Europe, we are looking for motivated, competent employees who have a sense of responsibility and adventure. Our target group consists of workers who are eager to work—especially on-site abroad—who are flexible and skilled in languages.
Basic Requirements:Knowledge of hydraulics, welding, and cutting is a plus.A solid understanding of electricity is a must.Troubleshooting various malfunctions is a challenge for the ideal candidate.Preferably, some initial work experience as a laborer and a flexible mindset.Willingness to perform physically demanding and dirty work (but done calmly rather than hastily).No fear of confined spaces (claustrophobia).Fluent in Dutch (additional languages are a plus); if you can communicate well in English, German, or French, you may also qualify.Flexibility regarding location and work schedule.Additional Information:You will primarily work within the country, but also regularly in Belgium’s neighboring countries (NL, DE, etc.).You will stay on-site from Monday to Friday. During weekends, you return home (you also receive a daily allowance for accommodation).You will not work every week of the year; there will be both busy periods (when execution takes place) and quieter periods.A driver’s license is not required.

jobs.occupation: Lawyer - Fund Structuring (Private Equity & Venture Capital)
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading boutique law firm in Antwerp specialised in corporate, tax and investment fund matters, and is recognised as a market leader in fund structuring.

• Advise clients on the structuring and set-up of investment funds (PE & VC)
• Support the full lifecycle of funds, from formation to ongoing operations
• Assist with drafting and reviewing fund documentation and agreements
• Contribute to capital raising processes and investor-related documentation
• Provide support on regulatory and compliance matters relevant to investment funds
• Conduct legal research and analysis on complex fund-related topics
• Work closely with senior lawyers and directly interact with clients on active matters

Our client is a global engineeringandsupply-chain services provider operating across 17 countries and supporting more than 25 industrial customers worldwide. They work with leading companies in sectors such as aerospace, automotive, medical devices, marine, energy, and precision machining. To strengthen their team in Belgium, they are looking for a Site Engineer who will support a demanding aerospace client on-site , working closely with production and manufacturing engineering teams.

Jobomschrijving

• Support customer manufacturing engineering teams on tooling, cutting tools, abrasives, and machining processes.
• Troubleshoot technical issues, provide recommendations, and ensure reliable technical service on the production floor.
• Analyse production needs, propose alternatives, and support optimisation projects.
• Collaborate with supply and logistics teams to ensure smooth workflow and on-time delivery.
• Ensure availability of critical tooling and support inventory optimisation.
• Act as the primary technical contact for the on-site customer.
• Build strong relationships with production engineers, management, and tooling suppliers.
• Support cost-saving initiatives and contribute to productivity improvements. 
• Monitor technical KPIs: delivery performance, tooling reliability, cost optimisation, etc.
• Collaborate with the local Belgian team (supply chain, logistics, junior engineer).
• Provide guidance and support to junior and operational staff as needed.

• Master's degree in Mechanical or Electromechanical Engineering or related field.
• minimum of 5 years of experience in a manufacturing environment (aerospace, automotive, medical devices, CNC machining, marine, or energy or other relevant field).
• Experience in production engineering or manufacturing engineering is preferred.
• Experience in supply chain environments is an advantage.
• Hands-on mentality and strong problem-solving capability.

• English & French (professional working proficiency).

jobs.description:

Provide full administrative support to the VP, including calendar management, prioritization of meetings, screening calls and emails, and coordinating daily tasks.
